PixelFX 0.3.1, vendored from https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx at commit
5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826. Only the requested effects and their
transitive source dependencies are included. See LICENSE and NOTICE.md.

Upstream names differ from the requested aliases: pistol-shot is muzzle-pistol,
sci-fi is scifi, critical-hit is crit-hit, and spawn-and-death is spawn.
